reason: compiler-ci and compiler-frontend-ci: pull_request or push to main; r-preflight: push to r-fast/**; archive branch matches none and no PR is created

workflows.content:
name: Compiler validation

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  validate:
    name: ${{ matrix.name }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: GCC
            compiler: gcc-13
            sanitizer: none
          - name: GCC Release
            compiler: gcc-13
            sanitizer: none
            build_type: Release
          - name: Clang
            compiler: clang-23
            sanitizer: none
          - name: ASan
            compiler: clang-23
            sanitizer: address
          - name: UBSan
            compiler: clang-23
            sanitizer: undefined
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Host prerequisites from signed Ubuntu repositories
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "T757 Stage A1: preinstalled tools before signed apt"
          echo "T757 ImageOS=${ImageOS:-unset} ImageVersion=${ImageVersion:-unset} PATH=$PATH"
          for tool in cmake gcc-13 g++-13 make python3 zstd; do
            echo "T757 tool $tool=$(command -v "$tool")"
          done
          cmake_before=$(command -v cmake)
          cmake_version=$(cmake --version | sed -n '1s/^cmake version //p')
          echo "T757 cmake_before=$cmake_before version=$cmake_version"
          python3 - "$cmake_version" <<'PY'
          import re
          import sys
          match = re.fullmatch(r"(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)", sys.argv[1])
          if not match:
              sys.exit("STOP: unknown preinstalled CMake version")
          major, minor, patch = map(int, match.groups())
          if not ((3, 28) <= (major, minor) < (4, 0)):
              sys.exit("STOP: preinstalled CMake outside project policy [3.28,4.0)")
          PY
          for pkg in gcc-13 g++-13 make python3 zstd libstdc++6 zlib1g-dev libzstd-dev libtinfo-dev libxml2-dev; do
            dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package}=${Status} ${Version}\n' "$pkg" || true
          done
          apt_started=$(date +%s)
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y \
            gcc-13 g++-13 make python3 zstd \
            libstdc++6 zlib1g-dev libzstd-dev libtinfo-dev libxml2-dev
          echo "T757 A1 apt_seconds=$(( $(date +%s) - apt_started ))"
          test "$(command -v cmake)" = "$cmake_before"
          echo "T757 cmake_after=$(command -v cmake) version=$(cmake --version | sed -n '1s/^cmake version //p')"
          test "$(cmake --version | sed -n '1s/^cmake version //p')" = "$cmake_version"
      - name: Restore untrusted fixed-SHA curated SDK archive cache
        id: sdk-cache
        uses: actions/cache/restore@3edfce9056124e459a23f683a21433670d47daca
        with:
          path: .deps/downloads/newlang-llvm-23.1.3-linux-x64-final.tar.zst
          key: t449-ubuntu-24.04-x86_64-5369d292ef513d32758634f98ec7cf62c52f82a0a333eb330ecf9a325648b133
      - name: Bootstrap SHA-verified curated LLVM 23.1.3 (cache or fixed Release)
        run: python3 scripts/bootstrap.py
      - name: Check C formatting and provide exact pinned-formatter correction
        if: matrix.name == 'Clang'
        run: |
          . .deps/activate.sh
          echo "Actions commit: $GITHUB_SHA; checked HEAD: $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          echo "PR head: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}"
          FORMAT_SUGGESTIONS_PATCH="$RUNNER_TEMP/format-suggestions.patch" bash scripts/check-format.sh

      - name: Upload formatter suggestions (untrusted; inspect before git apply)
        if: ${{ always() && matrix.name == 'Clang' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: clang-format-suggestions-${{ github.sha }}-attempt${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/format-suggestions.patch
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Configure, build, and test
        env:
          CC: ${{ matrix.compiler }}
          # Clang 23.1.3 emits this known GCC libstdc++ install-dir warning on
          # some Ubuntu GCC13/14 hosts. It stays a warning; unrelated -Werror
          # and every sanitizer/test rejection remain intact.
          CFLAGS: ${{ matrix.compiler == 'clang-23' && '-Wno-error=gcc-install-dir-libstdcxx' || '' }}
        run: |
          . .deps/activate.sh
          cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{ matrix.build_type || 'Debug' }} \
            -DNEWLANG_SANITIZER=${{ matrix.sanitizer }} \
            -DCMAKE_PROJECT_INCLUDE="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/cmake/independent-r-tests-hook.cmake"
          echo "T753 runner nproc=$(nproc) nproc_all=$(nproc --all)"
          echo "T753 affinity=$(grep "^Cpus_allowed_list:" /proc/self/status || true)"
          grep -E "^Mem(Total|Available):" /proc/meminfo | sed "s/^/T753 /"
          for f in /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.current; do
            if test -r "$f"; then echo "T753 $f=$(cat "$f")"; fi
          done
          ctest --version | head -n 1
          detected_nproc=$(nproc)
          case "$detected_nproc" in
            ""|*[!0-9]*) echo "::error::T753 invalid nproc: $detected_nproc"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          if test "$detected_nproc" -lt 1; then echo "::error::T753 nproc must be positive"; exit 1; fi
          ctest_cap=4
          if test "${{ matrix.name }}" = "ASan" || test "${{ matrix.name }}" = "UBSan"; then ctest_cap=3; fi
          ctest_workers="$detected_nproc"
          if test "$ctest_workers" -gt "$ctest_cap"; then ctest_workers="$ctest_cap"; fi
          echo "T753 chosen CTest workers=$ctest_workers detected=$detected_nproc cap=$ctest_cap"
          echo "T762 build workers=$detected_nproc detected_nproc=$detected_nproc"
          build_started=$(date +%s)
          cmake --build build --parallel "$detected_nproc"
          echo "T753 build_wall_seconds=$(( $(date +%s) - build_started ))"
          ctest_started=$(date +%s)
          set +e
          ctest --test-dir build --parallel "$ctest_workers" --output-on-failure
          ctest_status=$?
          set -e
          echo "T753 ctest_wall_seconds=$(( $(date +%s) - ctest_started )) exit=$ctest_status"
          if test -r /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak; then echo "T753 memory_peak_bytes=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak)"; fi
          exit "$ctest_status"

      - name: Save verified original archive only on trusted successful main push
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && steps.sdk-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        uses: actions/cache/save@3edfce9056124e459a23f683a21433670d47daca
        with:
          path: .deps/downloads/newlang-llvm-23.1.3-linux-x64-final.tar.zst
          key: t449-ubuntu-24.04-x86_64-5369d292ef513d32758634f98ec7cf62c52f82a0a333eb330ecf9a325648b133

# LLVM-independent Production source/checker and existing C17/native reference
# regression only. PARTIAL evidence; never replaces the LLVM 23.1.2 full matrix.
name: Compiler frontend/C17 reference (NO LLVM; PARTIAL)

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  frontend-c17-partial:
    name: Production CHECK + C17/native reference (NO LLVM; PARTIAL)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Check out source without persisted credentials
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Verify available Ubuntu runner tools (no LLVM install)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for tool in gcc make cmake python3 ctest; do
            command -v "$tool"
          done
          gcc --version | head -n 1
          cmake --version | head -n 1
          python3 --version
          ctest --version | head -n 1

      - name: Configure and build the actual Production frontend with GCC (no LLVM)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          CC=gcc cmake -S . -B build-frontend \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug \
            -DNEWLANG_FRONTEND_ONLY=ON \
            -DCMAKE_PROJECT_INCLUDE="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/cmake/independent-r-tests-hook.cmake" \
            | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/newlang-frontend-configure.log"
          grep -F "Frontend-only: LLVM discovery and llvm.c_api smoke omitted" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/newlang-frontend-configure.log"
          grep -Fx "NEWLANG_FRONTEND_ONLY:BOOL=ON" build-frontend/CMakeCache.txt
          grep -Fx "BUILD_TESTING:BOOL=ON" build-frontend/CMakeCache.txt
          detected_nproc=$(nproc)
          case "$detected_nproc" in
            ""|*[!0-9]*) echo "::error::T762 invalid build nproc: $detected_nproc"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          if test "$detected_nproc" -lt 1; then echo "::error::T762 build nproc must be positive"; exit 1; fi
          echo "T762 build workers=$detected_nproc detected_nproc=$detected_nproc"
          build_started=$(date +%s)
          cmake --build build-frontend --parallel "$detected_nproc"
          echo "T762 build_wall_seconds=$(( $(date +%s) - build_started ))"

      - name: Inventory all CTests and assert Production CHECK, C17/native and public validators
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ctest --test-dir build-frontend -N \
            | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/newlang-frontend-ctest-inventory.txt"
          python3 - "$RUNNER_TEMP/newlang-frontend-ctest-inventory.txt" <<'PY'
          import pathlib
          import re
          import sys

          text = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
          names = re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*Test\s+#\d+:\s*(\S+)\s*$", text)
          total = re.search(r"(?m)^Total Tests:\s*(\d+)\s*$", text)
          required = (
              "cli.check_source",
              "frontend_build_policy.integration",
              "nested_u8_checked_c.integration",
              "u8_call_checked_c.integration",
              "north_star_v0_checked_c.integration",
              "node_join_same_locator_public_proof.unit",
              "node_two_normal_join_public_proof.unit",
              "node_join_public_negative.unit",
              "node_join_public_oom.unit",
              "node_join_both_public_oom.unit",
              "node_join_owned_poison.unit",
              "bootstrap_retry.offline",
          )
          missing = [name for name in required if name not in names]
          print(f"NO LLVM / PARTIAL: registered CTests={len(names)}, "
                f"reported={total.group(1) if total else 'MISSING'}", flush=True)
          print("NO LLVM / PARTIAL: required CHECK+C17/native+public-validator "
                f"names registered={len(required) - len(missing)}/{len(required)}",
                flush=True)
          if (not total or int(total.group(1)) != len(names)
                  or len(set(names)) != len(names)
                  or len(names) < 275
                  or "llvm.c_api" in names or missing):
              raise SystemExit("STOP: partial CTest inventory inconsistent, "
                               f"missing={missing}")
          PY

      - name: Execute every registered frontend/C17 CTest (NO LLVM; PARTIAL)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "T753 runner nproc=$(nproc) nproc_all=$(nproc --all)"
          echo "T753 affinity=$(grep "^Cpus_allowed_list:" /proc/self/status || true)"
          grep -E "^Mem(Total|Available):" /proc/meminfo | sed "s/^/T753 /"
          for f in /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.current; do
            if test -r "$f"; then echo "T753 $f=$(cat "$f")"; fi
          done
          ctest --version | head -n 1
          detected_nproc=$(nproc)
          case "$detected_nproc" in
            ""|*[!0-9]*) echo "::error::T753 invalid nproc: $detected_nproc"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          if test "$detected_nproc" -lt 1; then echo "::error::T753 nproc must be positive"; exit 1; fi
          ctest_cap=4
          ctest_workers="$detected_nproc"
          if test "$ctest_workers" -gt "$ctest_cap"; then ctest_workers="$ctest_cap"; fi
          echo "T753 chosen CTest workers=$ctest_workers detected=$detected_nproc cap=$ctest_cap"
          ctest_started=$(date +%s)
          set +e
          ctest --test-dir build-frontend --parallel "$ctest_workers" --output-on-failure
          ctest_status=$?
          set -e
          echo "T753 ctest_wall_seconds=$(( $(date +%s) - ctest_started )) exit=$ctest_status"
          if test -r /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak; then echo "T753 memory_peak_bytes=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak)"; fi
          exit "$ctest_status"

      - name: Verify real Production source/checker CLI path (NO LLVM; PARTIAL)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ./build-frontend/newlangc --check \
            tests/fixtures/node_join_same_locator.nl \
            > "$RUNNER_TEMP/newlang-check-stdout" \
            2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/newlang-check-stderr"
          test ! -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/newlang-check-stdout"
          test ! -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/newlang-check-stderr"
          echo "NO LLVM / PARTIAL: Production source/checker exit 0, zero stdout/stderr"

name: R-FAST self-service pre-PR preparation (NOT R validation)

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - 'r-fast/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: r-fast-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  preflight:
    name: R-FAST pinned format + GCC build + CTest registration only
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout immutable push SHA without persisted credentials
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 3
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Verify opt-in R-FAST push and exact immutable checkout
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = "push"
          case "$GITHUB_REF" in
            refs/heads/r-fast/*) ;;
            *) echo "STOP: not an opt-in R-FAST ref"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          test "$GITHUB_REF_TYPE" = "branch"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          test "$(git status --porcelain)" = ""
          test "${{ github.repository }}" = "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          echo "R-FAST event=$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME repository=$GITHUB_REPOSITORY branch=$GITHUB_REF"
          echo "R-FAST immutable_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD) event_SHA=$GITHUB_SHA attempt=$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
          echo "R-FAST preparation only: semantic CHECK execution, source-issued owned proof, native/C17, negative/OOM, ASan and UBSan NOT TESTED"
      - name: Signed Ubuntu prerequisites (unchanged trust)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cmake_before=$(command -v cmake)
          cmake_version=$(cmake --version | sed -n '1s/^cmake version //p')
          python3 - "$cmake_version" <<'PY'
          import re
          import sys
          match = re.fullmatch(r"(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)", sys.argv[1])
          if not match:
              sys.exit("STOP: unexpected CMake version")
          major, minor, patch = map(int, match.groups())
          if not ((3, 28) <= (major, minor) < (4, 0)):
              sys.exit("STOP: CMake outside reviewed interval")
          PY
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y \
            gcc-13 g++-13 make python3 zstd \
            libstdc++6 zlib1g-dev libzstd-dev libtinfo-dev libxml2-dev
          test "$(command -v cmake)" = "$cmake_before"
          test "$(cmake --version | sed -n '1s/^cmake version //p')" = "$cmake_version"

      - name: Restore untrusted fixed-SHA curated SDK archive cache
        uses: actions/cache/restore@3edfce9056124e459a23f683a21433670d47daca
        with:
          path: .deps/downloads/newlang-llvm-23.1.3-linux-x64-final.tar.zst
          key: t449-ubuntu-24.04-x86_64-5369d292ef513d32758634f98ec7cf62c52f82a0a333eb330ecf9a325648b133

      - name: Bootstrap SHA-verified pinned LLVM 23.1.3
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/bootstrap.py
          . .deps/activate.sh
          clang-format-23 --version | grep -F '23.1.3'

      - name: Strict pinned formatting (fail closed; never alter source)
        shell: bash
        env:
          FORMAT_SUGGESTIONS_PATCH: ${{ runner.temp }}/r-fast-format-suggestions.patch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          . .deps/activate.sh
          bash scripts/check-format.sh
          echo 'R-FAST FORMAT PASS (not semantics)'

      - name: Upload review-only formatter suggestions on failure
        if: ${{ failure() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: r-fast-format-suggestions-${{ github.sha }}-attempt${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/r-fast-format-suggestions.patch
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

      - name: GCC frontend-only host build and CTest registration inventory (NO tests executed)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          . .deps/activate.sh
          CC=gcc cmake -S . -B build-frontend \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DNEWLANG_FRONTEND_ONLY=ON \
            | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/r-fast-configure.log"
          grep -F "Frontend-only: LLVM discovery and llvm.c_api smoke omitted" "$RUNNER_TEMP/r-fast-configure.log"
          grep -Fx "NEWLANG_FRONTEND_ONLY:BOOL=ON" build-frontend/CMakeCache.txt
          grep -Fx "BUILD_TESTING:BOOL=ON" build-frontend/CMakeCache.txt
          n=$(nproc)
          case "$n" in
            ""|*[!0-9]*) echo "STOP invalid nproc: $n"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          if test "$n" -lt 1; then echo "STOP zero nproc"; exit 1; fi
          build_start=$SECONDS
          cmake --build build-frontend --parallel "$n"
          echo "R-FAST build_wall_seconds=$((SECONDS - build_start)) workers=$n"
          ctest --test-dir build-frontend -N > "$RUNNER_TEMP/r-fast-ctest-inventory.txt"
          python3 - "$RUNNER_TEMP/r-fast-ctest-inventory.txt" <<'PY'
          import pathlib
          import re
          import sys
          report = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
          names = re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*Test\s+#\d+:\s*(\S+)\s*$", report)
          total = re.search(r"(?m)^Total Tests:\s*(\d+)\s*$", report)
          required = (
              "cli.check_source",
              "frontend_build_policy.integration",
              "nested_u8_checked_c.integration",
              "u8_call_checked_c.integration",
              "north_star_v0_checked_c.integration",
              "node_join_same_locator_public_proof.unit",
              "node_two_normal_join_public_proof.unit",
              "node_join_public_negative.unit",
              "node_join_public_oom.unit",
              "node_join_both_public_oom.unit",
              "node_join_owned_poison.unit",
              "bootstrap_retry.offline",
          )
          missing = sorted(set(required).difference(names))
          if (not total or int(total.group(1)) != len(names)
                  or len(set(names)) != len(names) or len(names) < 275
                  or "llvm.c_api" in names or missing):
              raise SystemExit(
                  f"STOP: R-FAST CTest inventory invalid: reported={total.group(1) if total else 'missing'} "
                  f"parsed={len(names)} unique={len(set(names))} missing={missing}"
              )
          print(f"R-FAST REGISTRATION PASS: {len(names)} distinct CTests; "
                f"required {len(required)}/{len(required)}; NOT EXECUTED")
          print("R-FAST ONLY format, host build, test registration. "
                "SOURCE/CHECK/PROOF/C17/NATIVE/NEGATIVE/OOM/ASAN/UBSAN NOT TESTED")
          PY
